title: Constructible coefficients on the projective line
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, and let $S$ be of finite type
over $k$, and let $\Lambda$ be the finite ring killed by an
integer invertible in $k$ of [sbc-def-coefficient-conventions].
For every constructible
$\Lambda$-sheaf $F$ on $\mathbf P^1_S$, every
higher direct image
$R^q\pi_*F$, for $\pi:\mathbf P^1_S\to S$, is constructible.

proof.text: Use the complete adopted theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.hasConstructibleDirectImages_projectiveLine in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Finiteness.Projective. Its proof first works on affine opens, embeds a constructible sheaf into a finite sum of finite pushforwards of finite constant modules, applies the constructible embedding criterion, and identifies the higher images with those of the finite covers. A finite cover embeds in projective space over the affine base; its geometric fibres have dimension at most one by integral incomparability and projective-line base change. The complete source constant-module curve theorem supplies constructibility, using prime-coefficient curve finiteness and finite-coefficient devissage. Exactness for finite maps and additivity handle the finite sum. Etale localization glues over affine opens. Thus the existing unit route through finite pushforwards and projective curves is retained by the source proof; no local duplicate of it is elaborated.

Extract Finite Lambda and HasInvertibleExponent Lambda (Spec k) from hcoeff. Apply the adopted projective-line theorem to F, converting the hypothesis using isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff. Transfer its unbounded derived homology conclusion along rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility and convert back using the same constructibility equivalence. This proves the original public statement with unchanged parameters and every integer degree. The empty base and the zero coefficient ring require no extra assumption.
